decisions: Both grouped and standalone Toggle consume actual cn-toggle CVA classes; standalone does not emit invented data-size/data-variant attributes. Native heights 28/32/36px map sm/default/lg, with 8px small and 10px default/large corners,10px inline inset and 4px text/icon gap. Width is intrinsic, never copied 59/66px specimen text widths. The actual Root --gap stores numeric spacing units; this reference binds the 4px unit so default spacing 2 becomes native 8px. spacing 0 outline groups join logical borders/corners, including RTL. This fixes the reference styling against actual data-orientation/data-spacing attributes instead of depending on stale data-horizontal utilities; it does not fix or claim vertical primitive keyboard support. Raw Root consumes orientation without forwarding it, so reference groups remain horizontal. Group size/variant context wins over item appearance when set; array-valued group selection and boolean standalone pressed state remain distinct. RTL keyboard behavior requires Base UI DirectionProvider in addition to HTML dir. Focus and single/multiple selection follow actual composite/native button behavior; no toolbar role or invented onToggle event is added.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
